Container.Name: MinimalPOI
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, multi-user map for collecting places you love and planning trips that string them together. Drop a pin or paste a link to auto-fill details, rate spots, and turn places into a day-by-day route — all on a server you fully own, with no external services required. All state lives in a single /data volume (SQLite DB, images, signing key).
Container.Description: Self-hosted, multi-user map for collecting places and planning routes. Single container, single /data volume, no external services.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent state: SQLite DB, uploaded images, and the auto-generated signing key.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Signing key for login cookies. Leave blank to auto-generate into /data/secret.key.

Config.Name: SESSION_LIFETIME_DAYS
Config.Description: Optional. How long a login stays valid before re-authentication.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Optional. Set to 1 when running behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy so the app sees the real client IP and https scheme.

Config.Name: FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS
Config.Description: Optional. Trusted proxy IPs when TRUST_PROXY is set. Scope to your proxy's IP for stricter setups.
